decisions.reason: The black-finish range remains a good design-led extension of the core drainage portfolio, though the firm's 2024 withdrawal of another design-oriented item shows some risk of pruning less distinctive variants.
The shower channel for seamless coverings fits the firm's main business and modern bathroom planning needs, and its dedicated product presentation indicates strong ongoing commitment.

The pump-assisted shower drainage line supports barrier-free and difficult-installation use cases, but it is more niche and now faces some portfolio-overlap risk with the newer pump-drain shower channel.

The tileable floor drain with grating is closely tied to the established drainage offer and is the kind of standard, specification-friendly product a German specialist manufacturer usually keeps in range.

As a newly launched pump-drain shower channel with its own page, it appears strategically relevant for innovation and renovation projects, although newer technically specific products still carry some early rationalisation risk.
